ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Every natural person holding a controlling interest, senior management position, legal representative role, financial controller role, or authorized signatory position must be screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC Sanctions List, the EU Consolidated Sanctions List, the UK HMT Sanctions List, and the People's Republic of China Ministry of Commerce sanctions and export-control denial lists. All identified politically exposed persons (PEPs) are subject to enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior management approval, and transaction monitoring for at least 12 months after exposure ceases. Negative media and adverse-information checks must be run against independent licensed databases and locally credible sources. Screening must be refreshed at onboarding and again before any incorporation filing is submitted to SAMR and the banking partner.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Registration and Pre-Approval Online Service via the Integrated Enterprise Start-up Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name of a PRC WFOE must be in simplified Chinese characters. The mandatory four-tier name structure is: administrative division + distinctive trade name + industry or operating characteristic + organizational form. A foreign investor uses a Chinese transliteration of its corporate name for the record; no foreign-language name is registered as the legal name. Roman letters, English words, Arabic numerals, symbols, and mixed-script names are generally prohibited unless expressly approved under a trade-standard exception. A certified English translation may be used for banking and internal purposes but does not replace the official Chinese name registration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant receives a written or online decision stating the conflict, prohibited token, or missing naming tier. The applicant may file a written administrative reconsideration petition with the market supervision authority at the same level or the SAMR appellate department within 15 days of receipt. The petition must attach the revised four-tier naming proposal, evidence of trademark availability, and a short explanation why the proposed name is distinctive and not misleading. If reconsideration fails, an administrative lawsuit may be filed in the competent people's court within six months. A name reservation is valid for 30 days; renewal is possible by re-filing before expiration if the name remains available.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or commercial mail-forwarding address is not permitted and will be rejected by SAMR, the local tax bureau, and the banking system for a WFOE carrying out ISIC 2100 peptide synthesis contract manufacturing. The entity must lease physical industrial premises in an approved life-science or medical industrial park suitable for laboratory and GMP compliance. The lease must cover the incorporation term, display the company's registered name at the entrance, and provide a real operating footprint consistent with the declared peptide synthesis business. Mail-forwarding addresses will be treated as non-compliance and may trigger license refusal or administrative penalties.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Unannounced on-site inspection risk: HIGH, approximately 85% within the first 12 months. Checklist: (1) registered address identical to the actual laboratory and office; (2) valid lease agreement and rent payment records; (3) signboard matching the exact registered Chinese name; (4) laboratory equipment present and proportionate to declared peptide synthesis activity; (5) property zoned for industrial or medical laboratory use; (6) fire safety, environmental, and health approvals in place; (7) personnel present during business hours; (8) no letterbox-only or virtual-office indications. Municipal market supervision and tax authorities may coordinate with the drug regulator during the initial licensing inspection.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 21, 23, 24, 32, 46, 47, 48, 49 and 158; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China, Articles 26 and 31; Implementation Regulations of the Foreign Investment Law, Chapter II; Administrative Provisions on the Registration of Foreign-Invested Companies; Regulation on the Administration of Company Registration, Articles 1-21.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Enterprise Registration Department, Administration for Market Regulation of the municipal or district government where the registered office is located, acting under the State Administration for Market Regulation.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for the Registration of a Foreign-Invested Company, together with the Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Information Report; in practice submitted through the SAMR online enterprise registration window or the physical enterprise registration hall.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital is imposed on a wholly foreign-owned enterprise limited liability company for pharmaceutical contract manufacturing; the only binding capital requirement is the amount stated in the Articles of Association. Under Company Law Article 47, the sole foreign shareholder may pay the subscribed capital in instalments but must make full payment within five years from the date of establishment. China does not require a blocked escrow account; instead, the WFOE must open a capital contribution settlement bank account, and the shareholder must remit contributions through a traceable bank transfer. The bank receipt and the company's books evidence the paid-in capital. If the shareholder fails to remit by the agreed schedule, the company may demand payment and the shareholder loses the benefit of time for the unpaid portion. Contributions may be in cash or lawful non-monetary property other than labour services, and such non-monetary contributions must be assessed and transferred to the company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF CN_WFOE_LTD. ADOPTED IN WRITING ON [DATE] AT THE REGISTERED OFFICE, PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA. WHEREAS the company was duly incorporated under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision) and registered with the competent Administration for Market Regulation; WHEREAS the shareholders have adopted Articles of Association setting out the company name, registered office, business scope, share capital structure and governance arrangements; WHEREAS the board has reviewed the legality and purpose of the proposed contract manufacturing of therapeutic oligopeptides and intends to comply with all pharmaceutical, environmental, fire and foreign investment rules. NOW THEREFORE, IT IS RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS: (1) SHARE CAPITAL AND SUBSCRIPTION: the board confirms that the registered capital shall be as stated in the Articles of Association and that the sole foreign shareholder has subscribed for all shares upon incorporation. The board accepts the subscription, declares that each share is issued at par, and authorizes the general manager and chief financial officer jointly to open a capital contribution settlement account, to issue and serve capital contribution notices, to receive shareholder remittances, and to prepare registers and certificates recording paid-up capital, all subject to the five-year payment period under Article 47 of the Company Law. (2) REGISTERED OFFICE: the board adopts as the registered office of the company the address specified in the Articles of Association, being the physical premises located at the street address of the leased laboratory and manufacturing facility in China, and directs that all statutory notices, process service, and regulatory correspondence shall be directed to that address; any relocation requires a further board resolution and amendment registration. (3) BANKING AUTHORIZATION: the board approves the opening of one basic deposit account and such foreign currency, settlement, and payroll accounts as necessary at a commercial bank approved by the People's Bank of China. The bank is authorized to honour wire transfers, SWIFT instructions, cheques and electronic payment orders signed by at least two authorized signatories, namely the general manager and the chief financial officer, and the bank mandate and specimen signature cards are ratified. (4) STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: the board appoints [name] as General Manager, [name] as Chief Financial Officer, and [name] as Compliance Officer and Corporate Secretary, each with authority to execute permits, tax filings, employment contracts, bank forms and regulatory submissions, and to represent the company before the market regulation, tax, customs, ecology, fire and medical product authorities. (5) AUTHORITY AND EFFECTIVENESS: the chairman and any one officer is authorized to sign, stamp and file all applications, declarations, and instruments required to give effect to this resolution, which shall be effective immediately and remain in effect until amended or revoked by a later board resolution. BY ORDER OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation foreign investment eligibility screening, name approval, and document legalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial or municipal Administration for Market Regulation via the State Administration for Market Regulation online enterprise registration portal and China Government Services Online Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a negative-list screening under National Negative List for Foreign Investment Access to confirm peptide synthesis CMO lab is in the permitted encouraged or permitted category and does not trigger equity or capacity restrictions. Prepare the Chinese company name and English trade name, and apply for name pre-approval through the SAMR online registration portal. Foreign investor certificate and its translations must be notarized and apostilled under the Apostille Convention; all Chinese-language versions must be certified. Complete the Articles of Association in Chinese and English, the initial shareholders' list, and the authorization of the legal representative. Secure a compliant registered address with a valid lease and landlord documents. This step locks the corporate identity and validates the administrative classification before filing.
required_dossiers: Completed Application Form for Name Pre-approval
Notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation of the foreign shareholder
Power of attorney appointing the local registration agent
Identity documents of the proposed legal representative, directors, supervisor and manager
Draft Articles of Association in Chinese and English
Lease contract and property ownership proof for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is queried or rejected because of a conflict or prohibited wording, file a revised name application through the same SAMR online channel within 10 working days; if the SAMR decision is unlawful, apply for administrative reconsideration within 60 days or institute administrative litigation within six months under the Administrative Reconsideration Law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory incorporation filing and issuance of business license
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation, Enterprise Registration Hall, in the jurisdiction of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application through the SAMR online enterprise registration system or the physical registration window. Include all notarized investor evidence, the board resolution, and proof of address. The registrar reviews the legal capacity, shareholding structure, names, business scope wording, and registered capital. After verification, the company is entered into the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and the Legal Person Business License is issued. Any preliminary approval from the National Medical Products Administration relevant to pharmaceutical manufacturing should be evidenced in the business scope; if the scope includes manufacturing, include the intended drug manufacturing license note. The company is then lawfully formed and may commence non-production preparatory activities.
required_dossiers: Foreign investor certification and apostilled legalization
Articles of Association signed by the sole shareholder
Tenancy proof and registered office acceptance
Shareholders' resolution on incorporation
Appointment documents for directors, supervisor and general manager
Name pre-approval notice
Handwritten or electronic signature confirmation forms
Foreign Investment Information Report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the incorporation application is suspended or refused, obtain the written decision, rectify the missing documentation, and resubmit within 15 days; if the defect involves a business scope requiring pre-approval, obtain the NMPA pre-approval and file an amended application; challenge the refusal by administrative reconsideration before the same or higher SAMR within 60 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company seal creation, tax registration and statutory post-incorporation filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau seal filing division, local Tax Service Bureau under the State Taxation Administration, and municipal social insurance, housing fund and statistics agencies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the business license is issued, obtain the company seal, financial seal, legal representative's seal and invoice seal from a licensed engraving company, and file seal impressions with public security. Complete tax registration through the electronic tax bureau, including taxpayer status as small-scale or general VAT taxpayer, accounting rules, invoice quotas and tax filing calendars. Register with the social insurance agency, housing fund center and statistics department. Establish financial records under the Accounting Law. This step makes the entity operational for human resources and cash-flow management, but it is not yet licensed for drug production.
required_dossiers: Legal Person Business License
Legal representative identity document
Company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal and invoice seal
Seal filing certificate from public security
Articles of Association
Officer appointment notices
Electronic tax registration forms
Social insurance registration forms and housing fund registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If seal filing or tax registration is refused or delayed, present the business license and rectify local filing requirements, use the electronic tax bureau to update missing fields, and pay any late-registration penalty under the Tax Collection Administration Law; invoke the 60-day administrative reconsideration window if the authority rejects the corrected filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank account opening, foreign direct investment registration and capital contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAFE-accredited commercial bank and the local State Administration of Foreign Exchange through the banking platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the original business license, seals, legal representative passport or identity card, and the board resolution to open the basic deposit account and a capital contribution settlement account for RMB or foreign currency. Complete the foreign investment information report through the bank system to SAFE by authenticating the foreign investor's certificate, obtaining the relevant codes, and filing details before inward remittance. The sole shareholder shall remit subscribed capital in accordance with the schedule in the Articles of Association, strictly within the five-year deadline. Inward remittance is automatically reported to SAFE through the bank. The bank will issue a receipt, and the accountant will verify paid-in capital if required by the Articles of Association or the banking relationship.
required_dossiers: Legal Person Business License
Company seal, financial seal and legal representative seal
Legal representative passport or identity card
Certified board resolution approving bank accounts
Foreign direct investment establishment information form
Proof of source of funds and foreign investor identity
Apostilled certificate of incorporation of the foreign investor
Capital contribution schedule approved by the board
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the foreign exchange registration or inward remittance is blocked because of KYC or reporting discrepancies, supply source-of-funds evidence and corrected forms to the bank, coordinate with SAFE through the bank, and resubmit within 10 working days; if an overbroad freeze occurs, issue a written demand and seek administrative review with SAFE.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pharmaceutical manufacturing license, environmental impact assessment and fire safety clearance before production
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Medical Products Administration under the National Medical Products Administration, local Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau, local Fire and Rescue Section, and Emergency Management Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for a Drug Manufacturing License, including facilities description, quality management system, key personnel, the peptide solid-phase synthesis process, premises address and proposed product categories. Undergo the GMP inspection by the provincial Medical Products Administration and obtain the acceptance report. Concurrently, prepare the Environmental Impact Report and submit it to the ecology bureau for approval before construction or renovation; after approval, apply for the pollution discharge permit. Apply for special fire protection design review, fire inspection and acceptance. For hazardous chemicals, complete a safety assessment and file it with the emergency management authority, and register special equipment such as pressure vessels. Commence manufacturing only after all licenses, environmental approvals and fire acceptance documents are archived and in effect.
required_dossiers: Drug Manufacturing License application form
GMP quality manual and standard operating procedures
Facility layout, process flow and utility diagrams
Environmental Impact Report and approval document
Pollution discharge permit application package
Fire protection design and construction drawings with inspection records
Hazardous chemicals safety assessment if applicable
List of chemical reagents and material safety data sheets
Environmental monitoring reports for wastewater and air emissions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Drug Manufacturing License or EIA approval is denied, implement the corrective actions identified in the deficiency letter, submit a supplemented application and supporting evidence, and re-apply; appeal the negative decision through administrative reconsideration within 60 days, then to the People's Court within six months.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Provincial Medical Products Administration under the National Medical Products Administration, with the local Municipal Market Regulation Bureau for business scope registration and the local Ecology and Environment Bureau for environmental permitting
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Drug Manufacturing License for active pharmaceutical ingredients manufactured by chemical synthesis, together with GMP compliance certification through on-site inspection before manufacturing operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment through the provincial or municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full Environmental Impact Report required for pharmaceutical manufacturing projects employing chemical synthesis; the project is not eligible for simple environmental registration, and a separate Pollution Discharge Permit must be obtained before operation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater shall meet GB 21904-2008 for chemical synthesis pharmaceutical products, with pH 6-9, COD maximum 120 mg/L, BOD5 maximum 30 mg/L, SS maximum 50 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen maximum 25 mg/L, total nitrogen maximum 35 mg/L, and total phosphorus maximum 0.5 mg/L. Air emissions shall meet GB 37823-2019 pharmaceutical industry air pollutant emission standards, with non-methane total hydrocarbons maximum 100 mg/m3 and total volatile organic compounds maximum 150 mg/m3, plus the site-specific limits set in the Pollution Discharge Permit. Hazardous waste must be stored in compliant containers, labelled, and transported through the electronic manifest system within permitted storage periods, and final disposal shall only be made to a licensed hazardous waste treatment facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance requires Fire Protection Design Review and Fire Protection Acceptance or filing with the local Fire and Rescue Section before use, including functioning automatic alarm and suppression systems and an approved evacuation plan. Occupational clearance requires an occupational health hazard assessment, pre-use hazardous chemical hazard evaluation, medical surveillance for exposed workers, and registration of pressure vessels and other special equipment with the market supervision and emergency management authorities. If dangerous chemicals form part of the synthesis process, a worksite safety facility design review and completion acceptance from the Emergency Management Bureau are mandatory before production.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); online portals include the Electronic Tax Bureau and the fully digitalized electronic invoice service, with the national gateway at chinatax.gov.cn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the inbound WFOE, the statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN) is the Unified Social Credit Code endorsed on the business license issued by the State Administration for Market Regulation. The WFOE must: (1) incorporate as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company and obtain the business license, which simultaneously creates the tax registration record; (2) complete the supplementary tax registration and taxpayer qualification confirmation with the STA through the Electronic Tax Bureau within 30 days; (3) register the legal representative, financial officer, and tax officer and bind the enterprise to the digital tax risk control system; (4) select the Value Added Tax taxpayer identity, namely small-scale taxpayer or General VAT taxpayer, and complete the initial VAT classification; (5) file the tax bank account and tax settlement account information; and (6) activate the fully digitalized electronic invoice service for VAT invoice issuance and acceptance. A foreign non-resident parent does not require a separate Chinese TIN solely for shareholding; dividends are handled under the WFOE TIN and the statutory dividend withholding regime. For a foreign non-resident entity with a Chinese establishment, the STA assigns a non-resident taxpayer identification code upon tax registration for withholding and settlement of China-source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; the WFOE is a Chinese resident enterprise taxed on worldwide taxable income at the statutory corporate income tax rate of 25 percent, and is automatically an Enterprise Income Tax taxpayer and a Value Added Tax taxpayer in China. No pass-through treatment is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None under China's check-the-box or hybrid mismatch rules; the WFOE cannot elect pass-through status. The only relevant statutory election is the voluntary registration as a General VAT taxpayer for a small-scale taxpayer with annual taxable sales below the mandatory RMB 5,000,000 threshold, provided accounting systems are adequate.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the PRC Value Added Tax Law and its implementing regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT registration is triggered by the WFOE incorporation and business-registration record within 30 days; mandatory General VAT taxpayer registration is required when annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory fully digitalized electronic invoicing under the STA Golden Tax IV infrastructure; invoices must be issued, reported, and cleared through the Electronic Tax Bureau real-time tax control system, with anti-fraud digital stamping, institutional invoice coding, and authenticity verification on the National VAT Invoice Inspection Platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The WFOE may claim zero-rated VAT on exported goods where the peptide products physically depart from PRC customs territory under a valid Customs Export Declaration, and may claim zero-rating on qualifying cross-border laboratory/technical CDMO services that are supplied to an overseas enterprise and fully consumed outside China. Substantiation requires transfer of legal title, actual cross-border movement or offshore consumption, collection of foreign exchange from the overseas customer, and matching of customs, logistics, invoice, contract, and banking records.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration Form (Export Goods Customs Declaration) with export inspection/export rebate notation
Commercial Invoice (export invoice) issued by the WFOE
Bill of Lading or air waybill evidencing physical export from China
Foreign exchange collection receipt or export proceeds settlement slip evidencing repatriation of the export sales proceeds
Sales contract or purchase order with the overseas CDMO client
For peptide materials, export laboratory certificate/analysis certificate and any statutory export inspection certificate required by customs or health authorities
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is subject to joint STA-customs audit review using Golden Tax III/IV data matching, customs export data, logistics tracking, and bank foreign-exchange collection records. If a zero-rating claim is fraudulent or cannot be substantiated, the tax authority will claw back the refunded or exempted VAT, impose daily late-payment surcharge, and assess a penalty of 0.5 to 5 times the tax evaded under the Tax Collection Administration Law of the People's Republic of China. Serious cases are referred for criminal prosecution under the Criminal Law provisions on fraudulent export tax refunds and false VAT invoices.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBoC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Mainland China operates under a managed floating exchange rate system with structured capital controls. For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) in peptide synthesis CDMO, current account convertibility is broadly available for trade settlements, services, and profit remittance after tax clearance; however, capital account transactions remain permission-based and require prior registration or approval by SAFE. Inbound foreign direct investment (FDI) into the WFOE must be injected as paid-in capital through a dedicated foreign exchange capital account, supported by a Foreign Investment Information Filing, a valid business license, and a capital verification certificate issued after remittance. Foreign exchange capital funds cannot be used for debt repayment, equity investment outside the registered business scope, or RMB settlement outside approved purpose codes. Profit remittances to the overseas shareholder require annual statutory audit, financial statements, tax filing completion certificate, and bank account confirmation; dividends can be remitted after SAFE/operational bank review. Surplus working capital and principal repayments are not freely convertible. Repatriated export proceeds are subject to trade authenticity checks and may be retained in foreign currency accounts or settled under SAFE rules. This creates a regime of high current-account freedom but strict capital-account gatekeeping, requiring documentary discipline for treasury operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE's export foreign exchange monitoring framework, export proceeds must be repatriated to a domestic current-account foreign exchange bank account within 180 days after the date of customs export declaration. The exporter may keep the full amount in foreign currency or sell it to the designated bank for RMB; there is currently no statutory mandatory conversion ratio for general manufacturing exporters. Receipts exceeding USD 50,000 require the bank to verify customs declaration data and the corresponding commercial contract; any unrepatriated balance after 180 days must be explained through the bank's foreign exchange inspection system, with potential inclusion in the 'suspicious foreign exchange income' list.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account (FDI) / Basic Deposit Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Currency Account (CNY) / Foreign Exchange Capital Account
Capital Escrow Account / Working Capital Settlement Account
Basic Operating Settlement Account / FX Profits Remittance Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low / Not viable as primary banking rails. Mainland China's banking and payment regulations require any local-currency financial service provider to hold a banking license or a PBoC payment institution license. Offshore digital EMIs are not licensed to maintain RMB settlement accounts, cannot process domestic tax payments or social security contributions, and cannot act as receiving banks for SAFE-sanctioned inbound FDI remittances or export proceeds. They may only support ancillary cross-border collection/remittance outside China, but for the WFOE treasury they cannot replace a designated Tier-1 licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical in-branch appearance is mandatory for the legal representative, chairman, or the manager authorized by board resolution when opening the WFOE's basic RMB deposit account and foreign exchange capital account. Remote consular proxy opening is generally not accepted by Tier-1 Chinese banks for FDI capital accounts; if the sole legal representative cannot travel, the bank may permit an authorized signatory to attend with a notarized and apostilled/legalized board resolution, but the legal representative must provide passport bio-data page, proof of address, and a sworn signature specimen. Foreign directors are also subject to a face-to-face interview with the bank's compliance officer at a physical branch.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership chain controlled by an offshore parent or holding company with nominee shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation and memorandum/articles of association of the direct parent and any intermediate holding entities; a full corporate registry search; current register of shareholders; register of directors; notarized confirmation of ultimate beneficial owner; an organizational chart with percentage ownership; passport copies of all natural-person UBOs with proof of residential address; and an independent treaty-residency certificate where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, adverse media, PEP screening hits or conflicting names across multiple jurisdictions in the pharmaceutical CMO supply chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A global-party-risk screening report from the bank's KYB tool; a signed and dated sanctions declaration from the legal representative; negative media rationale with source documentation; independent audit of beneficial owners; passport and residence permits; bank references from the parent's home jurisdiction; and representation from a compliance officer that no sanctioned nations are involved.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk pharmaceutical activities with insufficient substantiation of corporate purpose or production revenue model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Drug Manufacturing License (GMP-style) from China's National Medical Products Administration (NMPA); solid-phase peptide synthesis workflow documentation; master-sales agreements and purchase orders from licensed counterparties; product list with CAS numbers; certificates of analysis for samples; audited financial statements or capital contribution schedule; and a business plan matching the registered scope of ISIC 2100.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Abnormal expected transaction flows, high turnover in professional fees, or large forex conversion disputes with prior tax/exchange declarations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Projected monthly cash flow and 12-month treasury forecast; tax filing receipts and VAT refund records from the State Taxation Administration; SAFE FDI filing confirmation and receipt vouchers; invoices from lawyers/consultants showing reasonable fees; board-approved budget; and an external accountant's statement on source and use of funds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound FDI funds must arrive by SWIFT MT103 from the foreign shareholder's banking account into the WFOE's dedicated foreign exchange capital account held with a designated SAFE-approved bank. The remittance instruction must state the SAFE inbound FDI purpose code, include the WFOE name and business license number, reference the underlying Foreign Investment Filing, and be classified as FDI capital injection. After receipt, the bank registers the transaction with SAFE; the certified public accountant then issues a capital verification report. RMB settlement can occur only after the bank completes authenticity vetting and the capital verification certificate is filed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For supply-chain settlements and royalty payments, use bank-to-bank SWIFT MT103 with the appropriate commercial trade purpose code. For documentary credit transactions, issue confirmed Irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit through the Chinese bank's correspondent network. For deferred-settlement trade, use Documentary Collections with draft and invoice unless cleared. All outbound transactions require underlying invoices, import/export declarations, and where relevant the NMPA export license for peptide products.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts with real trade or current-account transaction backing
FX swap agreements for matching receivables and payables with the designated bank
Currency swap and interest rate swap arrangements for capital servicing with SAFE-approved banks
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permitted for onshore WFOE entities; onshore RMB NDF contracts are not available under SAFE

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Report and Foreign Investment Comprehensive Report (combined enterprise annual report submitted through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) of the PRC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of the year immediately following the reporting calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inclusion in the Abnormal Operations List within 10 working days after the June 30 deadline; if unrectified for three consecutive years, inclusion in the Serious Violation of Law and Breach of Credit Enterprise List, which can trigger administrative revocation or strike-off of the WFOE registration, credit blacklisting, procurement restrictions, and fines of up to RMB 30,000 for false or misleading public disclosure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement Return, Financial Statements and Related-Party Transaction Reporting with contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration of the PRC (competent local tax authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 of the year following the reporting tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of overdue tax per day; late-filing penalties of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000; under-reporting or evasion penalties of between 50% and 500% of the underpaid tax; transfer pricing adjustments may also add special tax adjustment interest and trigger enhanced risk-based tax enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual FDI Stock Rights and Investment Information Registration (FDI Consolidated Equity Registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) via designated banks or the SAFE online foreign exchange administration system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before June 30 of the year immediately following the reporting year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Placement on the non-compliant enterprise list, refusal or suspension of foreign exchange receipts and payments by banks, warning and administrative fines up to RMB 300,000, and adverse effects on cross-border settlement and future investment procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Social Insurance Contribution Base Declaration and annual employee contribution reconciliation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau and the State Taxation Administration office administering social insurance collection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the local declaration window, generally May 1 to July 31 of the current contribution year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on overdue contributions; administrative fines of one to three times the unpaid contributions when the employer fails to pay after a supervisory order; forced judicial execution and social-credit listing for continued default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Drug Production GMP Self-Inspection Report and, where applicable, Drug Production License renewal or update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Medical Products Administration under the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) of the PRC
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: GMP self-inspection report due by March 31 of the following year; Drug Production License renewal application filed no later than six months before the license five-year expiry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Issuance of rectification orders, administrative fines, suspension of production, and revocation of the Drug Production License for sustained GMP failures, false self-inspection records, or unapproved changes to contract manufacturing scope.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: The mandatory audit trigger for a Chinese WFOE limited liability company is legal form rather than quantitative size: the PRC Company Law requires every limited liability company to appoint a licensed PRC CPA firm to audit its annual financial statements. There is therefore no balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemption for a WFOE. The audit obligation is reinforced for a pharmaceutical CDMO because NMPA and provincial drug authorities condition the Drug Production License and GMP compliance on audited financial position and continuing viability. For group consolidation purposes, audit also becomes mandatory if the WFOE is material to the foreign parent under the parent's applicable accounting framework, but that is a group reporting requirement rather than a PRC statutory threshold.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS or ASBE), issued by the Ministry of Finance and substantially converged with IFRS; the simplified Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises may be used only where the WFOE qualifies as a small enterprise and no parent-applicable IFRS or consolidated reporting requires full CAS; the statutory audit report must be prepared in Chinese and must express an opinion on CAS-based financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the PBOC and SAMR Beneficial Owner Information Administration Measures, a WFOE must compile beneficial-owner records covering individuals who directly or indirectly hold 25% or more of equity or exercise effective control; any shareholding transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be filed with SAMR within 30 days after the change. The annual business report to SAMR, filed between January 1 and June 30, serves as the annual confirmation of the ownership and beneficial-owner snapshot, and the WFOE must also annually reconcile its UBO records with banking AML and KYC due diligence requirements relevant to a peptide synthesis CDMO.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders roster) maintained under the PRC Company Law
Register of Directors and Supervisors with appointments, resignations, and term records
Register of Charges, Pledges and Encumbrances maintained for equity pledges and movable-property security granted by the company
Minute Book containing shareholders' meeting minutes, board resolution minutes, and supervisory board resolution minutes

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Registered office lease and corporate compliance agent market range: USD 2,000 - 60,000 per year depending on city and office class; dedicated local corporate secretarial and agent services: USD 800 - 5,000 per year.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Typical PRC statutory audit fee for a WFOE peptide-synthesis CDMO: USD 3,000 - 15,000 per annum for CAS financial statements; if parent-required IFRS or US GAAP reconciliation and group audit packages are added, USD 12,000 - 30,000 per annum.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying High-and-New-Technology Enterprises may reduce the CIT rate to 15%; small low-profit enterprises meeting the statutory thresholds (annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3,000,000, employees not exceeding 300, total assets not exceeding RMB 50,000,000) are effectively taxed at 5% on taxable income up to RMB 3,000,000 during the 2023-2027 preferential window; R&D expenses generally enjoy a 100% additional deduction; a CDMO WFOE engaged in therapeutic peptide synthesis located in a preferred western-region industry may be eligible for the 15% Western Development preferential rate; qualifying high-tech enterprises and technology-based small- and medium-sized enterprises may benefit from an extended 10-year loss carryforward for qualifying losses, while the general carryforward period is five years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return, Type A) together with supporting schedules (including Schedule A105000, A105050, A105080 and A108000) filed through the Electronic Tax Bureau portal of the State Taxation Administration in the jurisdiction where the WFOE is registered; quarterly provisional tax prepayments are filed on Form A200000 through the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual finalization plus quarterly provisional (instalment) prepayments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayment returns and tax payments are due within 15 days after the close of each quarter; the annual return and final settlement for a calendar-year-end WFOE are due by 31 May of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sales revenue from goods sold or services rendered in the taxable year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the gross contract manufacturing consideration for the peptide-synthesis CDMO, separately identifying any license, milestone, technology-assistance and service components. Cross-border service revenue performed for non-residents must be segregated to support VAT export treatment and to prevent re-characterization of treaty-protected royalty income as Chinese-source service income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sales (operating) costs, including direct materials, direct labour, manufacturing overhead and depreciation of laboratory and production equipment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs must be booked at arm's length and supported by contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation. If the WFOE purchases peptide intermediates, resins, reagents or manufacturing equipment from the overseas parent or an affiliate, the purchase price, mark-up and economic allocation must be benchmarked; artificially inflated intercompany costs are a primary audit red flag.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business taxes and surcharges, including urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges and stamp duties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: VAT is excluded from CIT cost. Foreign withholding taxes on inbound royalty or technical-service transactions are generally creditable under the foreign-tax-credit schedule rather than expensed here; do not double-claim in both the credit schedule and the cost box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses, including commissions, freight, insurance, marketing and promotion costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Commissions paid to a non-resident sales intermediary may create a service permanent establishment (PE) for the intermediary and attract withholding obligations if the intermediary habitually concludes contracts in China. Deductibility requires valid invoices, evidence of actual services and alignment with the arm's length standard.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative expenses, including management, compliance, finance shared services, legal costs and R&D administration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Parent-company general management fees and pure shareholder supervision costs are not deductible under the PRC CIT rules. CDMO-specific know-how, process-improvement and regulatory-affairs service fees are deductible only to the extent they are arm's length, actual and substantiated by activity records, with the corresponding non-resident WHT properly withheld.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial expenses, including interest on borrowings, bank charges, foreign-exchange losses and financing fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party interest is deductible only within the thin-capitalization limits (2:1 debt-to-equity for non-financial enterprises, 5:1 for qualifying financial institutions) and at an arm's length rate. Interest paid to the non-resident parent must be reconciled with the 10% non-resident WHT declaration; excessive interest is non-deductible and may be re-classified as a hidden profit distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment income, fair-value gains or losses and gains/losses on disposal of assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capital gains from direct or indirect transfers of assets deriving their value principally from a Chinese PE or Chinese immovable property may create Chinese taxing rights. The WFOE must coordinate with the non-resident seller's tax filing and ensure the CIT return reflects all disposal gains and any corresponding withholding filings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total profit (loss) before tax adjustments, after operating profit, non-operating income and non-operating expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Total profit must reconcile to the audited financial statements. A persistent low-margin result under the offshore CDMO contract while the parent captures innovation residual profits is a core transfer-pricing challenge; the tax authority will compare the WFOE's functional, asset and risk profile with the OECD TNMM manufacturing benchmark.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Additions to taxable income: non-deductible expenses, excessive intercompany charges, transfer-pricing adjustments, undocumented management fees, fines, penalties and disallowed depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All outbound payments to non-residents must be cross-referenced to withholding declarations and treaty-benefit files. Unexplained additions, especially for intercompany royalties or re-invoiced services, expose the WFOE to transfer-pricing assessment, GAAR adjustment and penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions from taxable income: exempt income, R&D super deductions, carryforward business losses and foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: R&D deductions require contemporaneous project records, personnel timesheets, qualifying expenditure schedules and scientific project classification. Any offshore royalty income effectively connected with a Chinese PE cannot claim treaty exemption at the non-resident level; the WFOE must ensure that the PE attribution and the annual return are consistent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after net tax adjustments and annual loss set-off.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This amount must reflect the arm's length profit attributable to the WFOE. A low-risk contract-developer and manufacturing organization is expected to earn a return proportionate to its employees, tangible assets and assumed warranty/compliance risks; residual economic profit allocated offshore without substance will be re-attributed to China.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed final CIT at the applicable rate after tax credits, quarterly instalments and final balance due or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile the annual final CIT with the four quarterly A200000 prepayments. The final tax payable must be settled before dividend distribution, and any subsequent profit remittance to the non-resident shareholder triggers the 10% (or treaty-reduced) withholding tax, which must be deposited within the statutory withholding timeline.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual or quarterly filings: up to RMB 2,000, increased to RMB 2,000-10,000 for serious violations under Article 62 of the Tax Collection Administration Law; late payment surcharge: 0.05% of the overdue tax per day; underpayment due to inaccurate non-resident reporting or transfer-pricing adjustments: 50%-500% of the underpaid tax under Article 63/64; failure to withhold on outbound dividends, interest or royalties: 50%-300% of the un-withheld tax under Article 69; failure to maintain or provide transfer-pricing documentation and related-party declarations: fines up to RMB 50,000 plus adverse inference; criminal tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201 may result in imprisonment of up to seven years for directors and direct responsible personnel.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding tax under EIT Law Article 37 on dividends paid by the WFOE to a non-resident corporate shareholder. Treaty relief commonly reduces the rate to 5% where the non-resident shareholder directly owns at least 25% of the WFOE's capital and satisfies the beneficial-owner and 365-day holding-period requirements under the relevant DTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: (1) The non-resident shareholder must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority. (2) The WFOE as withholding agent must collect the TRC, a beneficial-ownership declaration, audited or internally substantiated evidence of the shareholder's economic substance (employees, premises, turnover, decision-making and actual business activities) and the applicable DTA provision. (3) The WFOE files the treaty-benefit claim with the Chinese tax authority through the electronic withholding declaration system before or at the time of payment, attaching the contract, the TRC and the beneficial-owner form. (4) The tax authority examines whether the recipient is the beneficial owner under SAT Announcement No. 9 of 2018 and whether the income is effectively connected with a Chinese PE. (5) If the tax authority denies treaty relief, the statutory 10% WHT must be paid plus interest, and the non-resident may apply for a refund within three years under the Tax Collection Administration Law if the treaty conditions are later proven. (6) All withholding declarations must be filed and the withheld tax paid to the State Treasury within seven days after the date of withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: The statutory withholding rate on royalties and interest paid to a non-resident enterprise without a Chinese PE is 10% under EIT Law Articles 37 and 38. Applicable DTA rates commonly range from 5% to 10% for royalties on industrial, commercial or scientific know-how and from 5% to 10% for interest depending on the treaty jurisdiction and the recipient's status. A lower rate is granted only upon production of the TRC, proof of beneficial ownership and confirmation that the income is not attributable to a Chinese PE of the non-resident.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under SAT Public Notice No. 42 of 2016, a Local File is mandatory where the Chinese taxpayer's related-party transactions in a year include tangible-asset transfers or purchases exceeding RMB 200,000,000, intangible-asset transfers or licensing exceeding RMB 100,000,000, financial-asset transfers exceeding RMB 100,000,000, or related-party service transactions exceeding RMB
